name: civicresolve
description: CivicResolve — AI-Powered Civic Grievance Management Platform

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); console.log('[Render Build] Successfully synced frontend/dist to root dist for static publishing.');"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix frontend test

author: CivicResolve Team
